metadata.title: Activist Protest Collage with Metallic Overlay

retrievalProfile.description: A gritty, high-contrast protest scene featuring a central red geometric overlay and brushed metallic display typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: A dark, grainy black-and-white photograph of a crowd at a protest, partially obscured by a large, semi-transparent red geometric shape in the center. The composition is framed by bold, brushed-metal textured typography at the top and bottom.
coreVisualRelationships: High-contrast black-and-white background vs. vibrant red central graphic
Industrial metallic text texture vs. organic grainy photo texture
Geometric central framing vs. chaotic crowd movement

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A crowd of protesters fills the frame, centered behind a large red graphic that spans 70% of the height.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red geometric shape in the center acts as the primary focal point.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top metallic header, drop to the red central graphic, scan the protest signs, and finish at the bottom metallic title.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with figures, signs, and graphic elements.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Black and dark grey provide the base photographic layer.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Vibrant red (approx #C00000) defines the central graphic and highlights.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Silver/Steel grey with a brushed texture for the primary text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic text and the dark, desaturated background.
paletteRestrictions: Strictly red, black, white, and silver

characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters feature a horizontal brushed metal texture with vertical gradients simulating light reflection.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Use a wide, bold sans-serif for primary titles and a more condensed, tracked-out version for secondary metadata.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary geometric weight and wide stance.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Create a high-contrast, grainy black-and-white photo of a protest crowd with signs. Overlay a large, semi-transparent red geometric shape in the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add wide, bold geometric sans-serif text at the top and bottom. Apply a horizontal brushed-metal texture and a slight vertical gradient to the text.

verificationChecks: Does the text have a visible brushed metal texture?
Is the background photo sufficiently grainy and high-contrast?

postGenerationChecks: Text is centered and legible against the background.
Metallic texture looks like brushed steel, not just grey.
The red overlay does not completely hide the background details.
The overall mood is serious and activist-oriented.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Gritty B&W Crowd Photo] + [Central Red Geometric Overlay] + [Brushed Metal Wide Sans-Serif Typography].
